title: A Smart Shopper Abroad
story: Farhan, a young engineer from Chattogram, has moved to Toronto for work. Living on his own for the first time, he is learning to manage a budget, shop online, return faulty products and stand up for his rights as a consumer. His Canadian roommate Leo is an impulse buyer, while his sister Tania runs a small online clothing store back in Dhaka.
storyBn: চট্টগ্রামের তরুণ প্রকৌশলী ফারহান চাকরির জন্য টরন্টোতে গেছে। প্রথমবার একা থাকতে গিয়ে সে বাজেট সামলানো, অনলাইনে কেনাকাটা, ত্রুটিপূর্ণ পণ্য ফেরত দেওয়া আর ক্রেতা হিসেবে নিজের অধিকার আদায় করা শিখছে। তার কানাডীয় রুমমেট লিও ঝোঁকের বশে কেনাকাটা করে, আর তার বোন তানিয়া ঢাকায় একটি ছোট অনলাইন পোশাকের দোকান চালায়।

units.focus: Talk about spending habits and problems that have been going on
units.focusBn: চলতে থাকা খরচের অভ্যাস ও সমস্যা নিয়ে কথা বলা

sessions.tipBn: অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনও চলছে এমন কাজের সময়কাল বোঝাতে have বা has been-এর পরে verb-ing বসে; for ও since দিয়ে সময় বলা হয়।

items.en: Farhan has been tracking every dollar he spends in a budgeting app since he arrived in Toronto.
For the past two weeks, I have been trying to get a refund for a faulty pair of headphones.
Leo has been buying things on impulse lately, and his credit card bill shows it.
The store has been advertising the same so-called clearance sale for three months now.
Farhan has been comparing laptops and reading customer reviews all evening, hoping to find the best value.
Prices at our local grocery store have been creeping up steadily since the spring.

sessions.tipBn: have বা has-এর পরে not বসে, তারপর been আর verb-ing আসে।

items.en: I haven't been using my gym membership, yet the company keeps charging me every month.
Farhan hasn't been sticking to his budget since the holiday sales started.
The customer service team hasn't been answering my emails, which is incredibly frustrating.
Leo hasn't been checking his bank statements, so he didn't notice the double charge.
I haven't been buying brand-name products lately because the store's own brand is just as good.
Farhan hasn't been paying full price for anything since he discovered cashback apps.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Have বা Has শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject, been আর verb-ing আসে।

items.en: Have you been keeping your receipts in case you need to return anything?
Has Leo been using that buy-now-pay-later app again to pay for his new sneakers?
Has the company been ignoring your complaints since you first contacted them in March?
Have prices been rising this fast everywhere, or only in this neighborhood?
Have you been saving a fixed amount from each paycheck, as your sister suggested?
Has Farhan been waiting all week for the courier to deliver his replacement phone?

sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে have বা has, তারপর subject, been আর verb-ing বসে; How long দিয়ে কাজের সময়কাল জানতে চাওয়া হয়।

items.en: How long have you been waiting for the refund to appear in your account?
Why has the supermarket been charging extra for reusable bags since last month?
What have you been doing to cut down on unnecessary spending since you moved here?
Which websites have you been using to compare prices before big purchases?
Who has been sending you all those promotional emails about limited-time offers?
How much have you been spending each month on subscriptions you rarely use?

sessions.pattern: A longer text in the present perfect continuous
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে present perfect continuous দিয়ে কিছুদিন ধরে চলতে থাকা অভ্যাস ও চেষ্টার কথা বলা হয়।

items.title: The budgeting app
items.en: Farhan has been using a budgeting app for six months, and it has been teaching him hard lessons. Every evening he has been entering what he spent that day, from coffee to groceries. He has been noticing how quickly small purchases add up. Lately he has been cooking at home more often, and he has been putting the money he saves into an emergency fund.

items.title: Chasing a refund
items.en: Farhan has been trying to get his money back for a faulty blender for almost three weeks. He has been calling the helpline every other day, but he has been getting the same recorded message. Meanwhile, the company has been posting cheerful ads about its excellent customer care. Leo has been urging him to write an honest review and warn other buyers.

items.title: Tania's small business
items.en: Back in Dhaka, Tania has been running a small online clothing store from her bedroom. For the past year she has been learning what customers really want. She has been replying to every review, even the angry ones, and she has been offering free exchanges when sizes don't fit. Her sales have been growing steadily ever since.

units.focus: Explain what had already happened before a shopping decision
units.focusBn: কেনাকাটার কোনো সিদ্ধান্তের আগে কী ঘটে গিয়েছিল তা ব্যাখ্যা করা

sessions.pattern: Subject + had + past participle (+ before/by the time ...)
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের দুটি ঘটনার মধ্যে যেটি আগে ঘটেছিল সেটিতে had-এর পরে past participle বসে।

items.en: By the time Farhan read the negative reviews, he had already paid for the blender.
The Boxing Day sale had ended an hour before we finally reached the mall.
Leo realized that he had accidentally signed up for a yearly subscription.
Farhan had compared prices in four stores before he finally chose a new laptop.
The seller had promised a full refund, so I was shocked when he offered store credit instead.
After he had set a strict monthly budget, Farhan finally started saving money.

sessions.tipBn: had-এর পরে not বা never বসিয়ে আগের অতীতের কাজকে না-বোধক করা হয়।

items.en: Farhan hadn't read the return policy, so he didn't know about the 14-day limit.
I hadn't noticed the hidden delivery fee until I reached the checkout page.
The package still hadn't arrived by the date the website had promised.
We hadn't expected groceries in Toronto to be so much more expensive than in Dhaka.
Farhan had not kept the original box, so the store refused to accept the return.
Until that day, Leo had never questioned whether he really needed half the things he bought.

sessions.tipBn: অবাক হয়ে বা নিশ্চিত হতে চাইলে Hadn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন শুরু হয়, তারপর subject আর past participle আসে।

items.en: Hadn't you checked the return policy before you paid for such an expensive blender?
Hadn't the store promised a full refund if the product turned out to be faulty?
Hadn't Leo already canceled that streaming subscription when they charged him again?
Hadn't you read dozens of reviews before choosing that laptop last spring?
Hadn't the courier already tried to deliver the parcel twice before you called them?
Hadn't Tania warned you that those flash sales often come with hidden fees?

sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে had, তারপর subject আর past participle বসে।

items.en: What had you already bought by the time you checked your bank balance?
Why hadn't the manufacturer warned customers about the recall before the holiday season?
How much had Farhan spent before he finally set a spending limit?
Where had you seen that jacket before you found it cheaper online?
Which store had offered the best price on the laptop before the sale ended?
How many times had Leo contacted the seller before he left a one-star review?

sessions.pattern: A longer text in the past perfect
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে past perfect দিয়ে আগে ঘটে যাওয়া ঘটনা আর past simple দিয়ে পরের ঘটনা বলা হয়।

items.title: The blender that broke
items.en: Farhan had wanted a good blender for months, so when a flash sale appeared, he bought one immediately. He hadn't read a single review. Two weeks later, the motor stopped working. When he finally looked online, he discovered that dozens of buyers had already reported the same problem. By then, the seller had quietly removed the product from the website.

items.title: An impulse buy
items.en: Leo had promised himself that he would only buy groceries that Saturday. However, by the time he left the mall, he had spent over three hundred dollars on things he hadn't planned to buy. He had picked up a smart watch, two shirts and a fancy coffee machine. At home, he realized he had forgotten the milk and eggs.

items.title: A lesson from the market
items.en: Before he moved to Canada, Farhan had always shopped with his mother at a busy market in Chattogram. She had taught him to bargain, to check every vegetable and to count his change. In Toronto, fixed prices had confused him at first. But after he had lived there for a year, he understood that comparing stores was simply a different kind of bargaining.

units.focus: Talk about orders, deliveries, refunds and consumer rights
units.focusBn: অর্ডার, ডেলিভারি, টাকা ফেরত ও ক্রেতা-অধিকার নিয়ে কথা বলা

sessions.pattern: Subject + be (is/was/has been/will be/is being) + past participle (+ by ...)
sessions.tipBn: কে কাজটি করেছে তার চেয়ে কাজটিই বেশি জরুরি হলে be-এর উপযুক্ত রূপের পরে past participle বসে।

items.en: Your order has been shipped and will be delivered within three to five business days.
In Canada, customers are protected by law against unfair contract terms and misleading advertisements.
Farhan's parcel was left outside in the rain, and the box was completely soaked.
The faulty headphones were finally replaced after Farhan's third complaint to the manager.
Your refund is being processed and should appear on your statement by Friday.
All prices will be reduced by thirty percent during the end-of-season sale.

sessions.pattern: Subject + wasn't/hasn't been/cannot be/shouldn't be + past participle ...
sessions.tipBn: be-এর রূপ বা মোডালের পরে not বসিয়ে কর্মবাচ্যকে না-বোধক করা হয়।

items.en: The extra delivery fee wasn't mentioned anywhere on the product page until checkout.
Sale items cannot be returned or exchanged unless they are faulty or damaged.
Farhan's complaint hasn't been answered, even though it was submitted two weeks ago.
Customers shouldn't be charged every month for a subscription they never agreed to.
The damaged box wasn't noticed until the delivery driver had already left.
Personal data should not be shared with third parties without the customer's consent.

sessions.tipBn: কর্মবাচ্যের প্রশ্নে Is, Was, Has বা Will শুরুতে বসে, আর past participle পরে থাকে।

items.en: Has my refund been approved yet, or is it still being reviewed?
Are online sellers required by law to accept returns within thirty days?
Was the parcel signed for by someone at the front desk of your building?
Will I be charged a restocking fee if I return the opened laptop?
Is this winter jacket really made from recycled materials, as the label claims?
Were you given a written receipt when the exchange was completed at the counter?

sessions.pattern: Could you tell me / Do you know whether / I was wondering if + subject + be + past participle ...
sessions.tipBn: ভদ্রভাবে জানতে চাইলে Could you tell me বা Do you know-এর পরে সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো subject আগে আর verb পরে বসে।

items.en: Could you tell me when my refund will be processed and how it will be paid?
Do you know whether this item can be exchanged for a different size?
I was wondering if the delivery could be rescheduled for Saturday morning.
Would you mind telling me why my order was canceled without any notice?
Can you find out whether the missing parcel has been located yet?
I'd like to know how customer complaints are handled in your company.

sessions.pattern: A longer text in the passive voice
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে বিভিন্ন কালের কর্মবাচ্য দিয়ে প্রক্রিয়া, নিয়ম ও অধিকারের কথা বলা হয়।

items.title: A parcel gone missing
items.en: Last month, Farhan's new phone was marked as delivered, but it was never found. The tracking page said it had been left at the front door, yet nothing was there. A claim was filed with the courier, and his case was passed to a senior agent. Eventually, a replacement was sent, and he was offered a small credit for the trouble.

items.title: Know your rights
items.en: When Farhan's blender broke, Leo showed him how shoppers are protected in Canada. Products must be described accurately, and prices must be clearly displayed. If an item is found to be faulty, the buyer is usually entitled to a repair, a replacement or a refund. Farhan was told that similar rights are also guaranteed by law in Bangladesh.

items.title: How reviews are handled
items.en: Every review that is posted on Tania's online store is read by Tania herself. Negative reviews are never deleted; instead, they are answered politely within a day. If a customer is unhappy, a free exchange is offered and the new item is sent at no extra cost. As a result, her store has been recommended by hundreds of satisfied buyers.

units.focus: Reflect on past shopping choices and their results
units.focusBn: অতীতের কেনাকাটার সিদ্ধান্ত ও তার ফল নিয়ে ভাবা

sessions.pattern: If + had + past participle, would/could have + past participle (third) / ..., would + verb now (mixed)
sessions.tipBn: অতীতে ঘটেনি এমন কাল্পনিক শর্তে If-এর পরে had + past participle আর অন্য অংশে would have + past participle বসে; ফল এখনকার হলে would + verb বসে।

items.en: If Farhan had read the reviews, he would have chosen a more reliable blender.
If Leo had waited for the Black Friday sale, he would have saved two hundred dollars.
If I had kept the receipt, I could have exchanged the shoes for a bigger size.
If Farhan had started budgeting earlier, he would have more savings now.
If Tania had opened her online store earlier, she would have even more customers today.
If I were more patient, I would have waited for the price to drop.

sessions.pattern: If + hadn't + past participle, wouldn't have + past participle / wouldn't + verb now
sessions.tipBn: hadn't বা wouldn't বসিয়ে অতীতের কাল্পনিক শর্ত বা তার ফলকে না-বোধক করা হয়।

items.en: If the store hadn't offered free returns, I wouldn't have ordered three different sizes.
Farhan wouldn't have lost his money if he had paid with a credit card instead of cash.
If Leo hadn't signed up for so many subscriptions, he wouldn't be broke now.
If I had known about the hidden fees, I would never have completed the order.
If the courier hadn't left the parcel outside, it wouldn't have been stolen.
If Farhan didn't track his spending so carefully, he wouldn't have been able to afford the trip home last winter.

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + would + subject + have + past participle + if + had ...?
sessions.tipBn: Wh-শব্দের পরে would, তারপর subject আর have + past participle বসে; if-অংশে had + past participle থাকে।

items.en: What would you have done if the seller had refused to give you a refund?
How much would you have saved if you had bought the laptop during the sale?
Which phone would you have bought if you had read the reviews first?
How would your life be different now if you had saved half your salary last year?
Who would you have complained to if the store manager had ignored you?
What would Tania's business look like today if she had never started selling online?

sessions.pattern: A longer text with third and mixed conditionals
sessions.tipBn: অনুচ্ছেদে third ও mixed conditional দিয়ে অতীতের ভুল, শিক্ষা আর তার বর্তমান ফল বলা হয়।

items.title: The winter coat
items.en: Last November, Farhan bought the first winter coat he saw because he was cold and in a hurry. If he had compared a few stores, he would have found a warmer coat for less money. If he had checked the size chart, he would have ordered a larger size. Now he says that if he had been more patient, he would be much warmer this winter.

items.title: Leo's credit card
items.en: If Leo had read his statements every month, he would have noticed the extra charges much sooner. He would have saved hundreds of dollars if he had canceled his unused subscriptions. If he hadn't used his credit card for every small purchase, he wouldn't be paying so much interest now. Luckily, he has finally learned his lesson.

items.title: A good decision
items.en: Some choices turn out well. When Tania started her online store, she offered free exchanges from the first day. If she hadn't made that decision, many customers would have left angry reviews. If she had followed her friends' advice and sold only through a physical shop, she would not have so many loyal buyers across Bangladesh today.
